# Note

This block lets you write a simple note inside of your command or event builder that does not trigger any actions. Allows you to save information such as guides on how to setup the command.

{% hint style="info" %}
The Note action block does not modify the behaviour of your command / event.
{% endhint %}

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FUty4sO2pRbnvzBynWAhY%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=38d59800-f0e0-4466-aa17-aa2ed22cf680" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Title

The title for your note, this text will appear on the top of your note. A maximum of 100 characters is allowed in this field.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FmZEC3mX9rJa0LWxvjYKd%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=30c7a9be-cfae-4949-b5c6-6f8615f499e4" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Description

The description for your note, a maximum of 2000 characters is allowed inside of this field.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2FR3LV8XpJwaXLjSG9MeJx%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=316514fb-721f-4039-bb43-41b88f5a15be" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Note Color

The color for your note's title and outline. You may select an option by clicking one of the circles.

<figure><img src="https://1937909199-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-Lm_hW5MApY3J0lRhi0M%2Fuploads%2F6LU7EI3nWYf2YJKBU4Ok%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=ca97337a-ae5c-466a-9473-8503db8fa694" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
